args.title: Support q-values in Accept-Language header parsing for pickLocale

args.body:
label: bug
file: src/i18n/index.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The `pickLocale` function currently splits the `Accept-Language` header by commas and returns the first supported language it encounters, completely ignoring any `q=` quality values. Updating `pickLocale` to parse these quality values ensures that languages with higher weights are properly prioritized when selecting the locale.
